component.name: AppImage Manager
component.summary: Import, organize and launch AppImage applications

description.p: AppImage Manager is a desktop launcher for Linux users who want to keep their AppImage applications organized, validate permissions and launch them from a simple library.

ul.li: Import .AppImage files into a local library
Launch AppImages with a single click or double-click
Mark favorite apps for quick access
Open the folder containing any AppImage
Dark mode and multi-language support (English, Portuguese, Spanish)

screenshot.caption: AppImage library showing a registered application

description.p: Initial release with AppImage library management, permission handling and Flatpak packaging.
